description: Output schema for semantic audit agents. Each agent returns an array of test quality findings.

test_name.description: Name of the test function or block (e.g., 'test_load_policy_missing_file')

issue.description: One-line description of the quality problem

category.description: Which audit angle identified this issue

severity.description: critical = test is misleading, warning = test is weak, info = improvement opportunity

evidence.description: Specific code line or pattern demonstrating the issue
